purpose: Select NVIDIA AI-Q as the first runtime candidate after the NVIDIA skill integration pass, while keeping every clone, backend start, endpoint call, credential, and research query blocked until a specific human-approved runtime window exists.

sourceSkills.blueprintCompatibility: AI-Q Blueprint major version 2 with minor version 1 or newer
sourceSkills.plannedRole: Own locate, clone, environment, runtime mode, health validation, troubleshooting, shutdown, and handoff after approval.

sourceSkills.blueprintCompatibility: AI-Q Blueprint or endpoint major version 2 with minor version 1 or newer
sourceSkills.plannedRole: Run research only after a trusted reachable AIQ_SERVER_URL is verified and the user confirms the endpoint for the query.

runtimeCandidate.frontendUi: disabled for first approval window unless explicitly selected
runtimeCandidate.credentialModel: Credentials stay outside chat and outside committed files; presence-only checks are allowed only during an approved runtime window.
runtimeCandidate.authBoundary: REQUIRE_AUTH=false is acceptable only for trusted local single-user validation; shared or internet-facing deployments require authentication review first.
runtimeCandidate.handoffRule: Only hand AIQ_SERVER_URL to aiq-research after basic deploy validation passes and the endpoint is trusted for the requested query.

approvalChecklist: Confirm AI-Q is the selected lane for this runtime window.
Confirm target mode: backend-only, CLI, local web UI, Docker Compose, or Kubernetes/Helm.
Confirm the AI-Q checkout location is outside risky SEIS product source paths or is explicitly reviewed.
Confirm repo clone/update is allowed and network access is approved.
Confirm license and third-party dependency risk are acceptable for the selected checkout.
Confirm disk, port, Docker, Python, Node, Kubernetes, Helm, GPU, and cloud requirements for the selected mode.
Confirm deploy/.env is ignored before any secrets are written.
Confirm credentials are configured by the user outside chat and outside committed files.
Confirm any non-local AIQ_SERVER_URL is trusted before a query is sent.
Confirm whether shallow validation is enough or deep research completion validation is approved.
Confirm rollback and shutdown expectations before starting services.
Confirm no GitHub write, deployment, SSH, or public claim is included in this runtime window.

plannedRuntimePhases.description: SEIS records AI-Q Deploy and AI-Q Research as installed-gated NVIDIA capabilities with Desktop, Store, Search, AI, Cloud, docs, and validator visibility.
Locate an existing AI-Q checkout or inspect whether one must be cloned, without changing files or contacting services.
Clone or update the AI-Q repository if needed, then prepare deploy/.env only after ignore rules are confirmed and user-managed credentials are ready.
Start the selected backend-only AI-Q runtime path and keep frontend UI disabled unless separately requested.
Run health checks and async-agent compatibility checks; run shallow chat only if credentials are present and the user approves.
Use aiq-research only after the exact AIQ_SERVER_URL is stated and trusted for the request.
Stop services without destructive volume deletion unless separately approved; record validation limits and next work.

blockedActions: Create or modify deploy/.env without approval and ignore-rule proof.
Read, print, store, or commit NVIDIA_API_KEY, search provider keys, cookies, bearer tokens, or private credentials.
Start Docker Compose, local Python, local Node, Helm, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or GPU-backed services.
Bind localhost ports for AI-Q backend or frontend without approval.
Call AI-Q health, chat, async-agent, polling, or report endpoints before a runtime window is approved.
Send a research query to a non-local backend without explicit trust confirmation.
Run deep research completion validation without approval for time, quota, and data exposure.
Use SSH, cloud, cluster, GitHub write, deployment, or public release actions.

runtimeValidationPlan.basicHealth: curl health checks only after approved runtime start.
runtimeValidationPlan.asyncAgentCompatibility: aiq-research helper health and agents commands only after AIQ_SERVER_URL is trusted.
runtimeValidationPlan.shallowChat: Allowed only when credentials are configured outside chat and approved for this validation.
runtimeValidationPlan.deepResearch: Optional and separately approved because it can take substantial time and quota.
runtimeValidationPlan.successClaimBoundary: Until runtime validation is actually run, SEIS may only claim AI-Q is planned and allowlisted, not deployed or reachable.

desktopSurface.primaryUserAction: Review approval checklist before any runtime command.

securityNotes: Core SEIS still works without NVIDIA credentials.
No provider key belongs in browser localStorage, IndexedDB, committed docs, or chat logs.
AI-Q backend URLs can receive prompt text and metadata; non-local endpoints require explicit trust confirmation.
Public demo claims must say planned/gated until runtime validation evidence exists.
